findings.title: CA available_time_utc rows carry ET-stamps-as-UTC in the PIT authority file
findings.detail: Raw WDS archive bytes say releaseTime '2023-12-19T08:30' (undesignated, America/Toronto per StatCan convention); the p3 clock rows write 'T08:30:00Z'. True UTC is 12:30Z (EDT) / 13:30Z (EST), so the recorded availability is 4-5h EARLY. Demonstrated immaterial at the only consumer: the decision clock is daily 16:00-NY bars, and no 16:00-NY daily bar exists between 08:30Z and 13:30Z, so F/D/X and every decision are identical under both readings (checked for anchor, neighbour sham shift, and control anchoring). But the field label is wrong in a sha-pinned authority file; must be corrected before any intra-day clock ever consumes CA stamps. Append-only discipline (values never edited) was respected - the fix belongs in a superseding authority row, not an edit.
